about.body: ORHA detects connections to eras still unknown. Objects, species, technologies, anomalies… every discovery becomes **an Archive to add to your collection.**

eden.body: **30** Archives bear witness to this new world.

rarities.bodyLine1: Every Archive belongs to a **rarity tier**.
rarities.bodyLine2: Its classification is **revealed only at the moment of its discovery.**

collection.bodyLine2: Complete the seasons, uncover the rarest and **leave your trace in the Registry.**

packs.body: Every collector receives one free transmission per day. **Reserve additional transmissions now at the pre-launch** price, available in your account as soon as ORHA opens.
packs.purchaseSuccessBody: Payment confirmed. **{count} extra transmissions** have been credited to your account.
packs.purchaseCancelled: Purchase cancelled — you haven't been charged.
packs.purchaseError: The payment couldn't be started. Please try again shortly.
packs.disclaimer: These transmissions are added to your free daily opening. They do not increase your chances of obtaining any particular rarity.

finalCta.body: Join ORHA's first collectors and be notified the moment EDEN opens.
